component.name: CardHorizontal
component.description: A course card with a square thumbnail on the left and the title, progress and metadata beside it.

useWhen: Listing started or saved courses in the User Settings page
Displaying course recommendations in a footer or sidebar with an inverted dark background
The card opens the course page: pass href. Omit it only when something else on the page opens the course.

notFor.case: Using CardHorizontal for non-course content (e.g., user profile, article)
notFor.because: The fixed 80×80 thumbnail and metadata row are designed for course items.
notFor.note: Use Card with a custom inner layout for other content types.

notFor.case: Passing long course titles and expecting them to wrap
notFor.because: The title is a single line with an ellipsis. Sighted users lose the truncated text (screen readers still get the full title), and the risk grows at 200% zoom.
notFor.note: Keep titles short enough to fit the list width. Use CardVertical when titles are long.

useWhen.default: Cards on the page's default or elevated surface.
useWhen.inverted: Cards in a dark footer or other inverted band. Inverted text; the parent supplies the dark fill.

donts.case: Placing CardHorizontal in a section whose heading is not an h2 (e.g. directly under the page h1, or inside an h3 subsection)
donts.because: The title always renders as an h3 (there is no heading-level prop), so any parent heading other than h2 skips or inverts a level in the document outline.
donts.instead: Put CardHorizontal lists inside a section headed by an h2. If a layout needs another level, raise it as a component change (a titleAs prop) instead of wrapping or restyling the card.

donts.case: Wrapping CardHorizontal in an <a> or putting an onClick on it
donts.because: A wrapping link reads the whole card as one long link name, and a click handler isn't reachable by keyboard.
donts.instead: Pass href: the card links through its title and the link covers the card.

donts.case: variant inverted without a dark parent, or inside data-theme="dark"
donts.because: The card draws no background; its inverted text assumes the parent's inverted fill, and data-theme="dark" switches every token in the subtree instead.
donts.instead: Place it in a Box with background="inverted", as in the footer-recommendations pattern.

patterns.name: started-courses-list
patterns.useWhen: Listing the courses a learner has started, with their progress.

patterns.name: footer-recommendations
patterns.useWhen: Promoting courses the learner hasn't started on a dark footer or other inverted band.

patterns.name: certified-badge
patterns.useWhen: Showing a course's certified status outside a card, e.g. in a course-detail metadata row.
